references.text: Moses gave orders to equip men for war against the Midianites, which led to the commanders now returning.
Eleazar was the son of Aaron and took over the role of high priest. He is mentioned here alongside Moses as one of the leaders.
Jethro, Moses' father-in-law, was met outside the camp by Moses, a similar example of going out to meet someone.
The chiefs (נְשִׂיאֵי הָעֵדָה) were the leaders of the tribes of Israel who played a central role in organizing the people.
The area outside the camp had special significance for purity and rituals in Israelite practice.
Outside the camp was the place for those who were unclean, and the warriors had to undergo purification before they could enter the camp.
